precise_gate_sketch:
if offset == 0:
    binding_path = out / 'binary-binding.json'
    b = read_json(binding_path)
    require(b['status'] == 'VERIFIED' and b['historical_report_modified'] is False, 'CPU offset0 binary binding identity')
    require(b['original_report'] == path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() and b['original_report_sha256'] == sha(path), 'CPU offset0 original report binding mismatch')
    require(b['actual_executable'] == binary.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() and b['actual_executable_sha256'] == sha(binary), 'CPU offset0 expected executable binding mismatch')
    require(b['firmware_binary_sha256'] == sha(out / 'revd-driver.bin'), 'CPU offset0 firmware binding mismatch')
    require(b['cpu_command_record_sha256'] == sha(out / 'cpu.log.command.json'), 'CPU offset0 command binding mismatch')
    require(b['cpu_log_sha256'] == sha(out / 'cpu.log') == cmd['log_sha256'], 'CPU offset0 log binding mismatch')
